title: Artemis Fowl
author: Eoin Colfer
summary: Twelve-year-old criminal mastermind Artemis Fowl kidnaps a fairy officer from the hidden People, hoping to ransom her for gold. Captain Holly Short's underground police force must get her back, using technology as well as magic.
readIf: you like clever young antiheroes and fantasy mixed with gadgets and jokes.
skipIf: you prefer serious, lyrical fantasy over brisk, tongue-in-cheek capers.
